dropped_vulns.reason: peer-token iss/iat/nbf claim hardening: through the real federation endpoint the token must already be signed by the registered peer's key (the row is looked up by iss and the signature is checked against that peer's pubkey), so the missing iss/iat/nbf checks are defense-in-depth rather than an attacker-reachable bypass. Not reproducible as a distinct exploit through the entry point.

retiring legacy SHA-256 API-key hashes after a configured deadline; the rejection on fixed code surfaces from the rate-limit middleware as a 500 rather than a clean 401, making a crisp through-the-endpoint assertion messy. Dropped for test cleanliness.
the SQL-injection facet is in the PostgreSQL backend, which needs a running Postgres server; kept the task offline/lean and used the SQLite-reachable storage-permission facet (V6) instead.
webhook SSRF was introduced and fixed much later (≈0.9.0a11), not open at commit C.

verified.exploit_entry_point: All six are driven through the installed node's public surfaces only: the FastAPI HTTP app from stigmem_node.main.create_app (peer registration POST /v1/federation/peers and federation data GET /v1/federation/facts), node service startup/configuration (create_app lifespan validation), node DB initialisation on startup (apply_migrations), and the plugin-registration entry point register_discovered_plugins.
variants: V1a: a self-signed peer declaration posted to /v1/federation/peers returns status 'active' on C (must be a non-active, approval-pending state).
V1b: the self-registered peer's bearer token is accepted (200) at GET /v1/federation/facts on C (must be 401 until approved).
V2: federation with mTLS disabled boots on a non-loopback node_url (two hosts: a DNS name and a public IPv4).
V3: authentication disabled boots on a non-loopback node_url (two hosts).
V4: an unsigned plugin is registered via register_discovered_plugins with signing disabled and no acknowledgement.
V5: the node boots with read=write rate limits at 0 and no acknowledgement.
V6: the SQLite database file is created mode 0644 (group/other readable) after startup.
verified.proof_present_at_C: On a checkout of C (installed editable), the nine security tests all FAIL (each exploit succeeds) and the six functional tests all PASS. After applying solution/fix.patch (the real upstream source fixes for all six, applied together, plus migration 038), all fifteen PASS. Verified by running tests/security + tests/functional in the task's own python:3.12-slim image both before and after the patch.
verified.project_tests_run: The project's own federation and auth suites run offline against the default SQLite backend at C (node/tests/federation + node/tests/auth: 242 passed). The task's tests reuse the same TestClient + SQLite + Ed25519 harness pattern but are fully self-contained under /tests and never import from /app/node/tests.

patch_checks._why: 2026-10-16: reference fix keyed on the bind host (settings.host) instead of node_url, as the instruction's 'bound to' wording and the repo's own comment suggest. Tests now set both, so either keying must pass.

2026-10-16 test repair: reference fix whose quota guard reads an undeclared acknowledgement setting, so zeroed quotas crash startup with AttributeError instead of a deliberate refusal (and the acknowledged mode can never start). The old V5 test accepted any exception; the narrowed refusal check must fail it.

2026-10-16 test repair: reference fix whose auth guard refuses every non-loopback deployment, even with authentication on. Passed the old tests (all functional boots were loopback); test_secure_node_boots_on_public_address must fail it.

notes: Stacking task at a single commit C where six real, independent security flaws are simultaneously open, all fixed across the v0.9.0a1->v0.9.0a2 hardening batch. solution/fix.patch = the real upstream source fixes applied together (node/src/stigmem_node: main.py startup validation = V2/V3/V5; plugins/signing.py = V4; db.py = V6; routes/federation + _federation_impl.py + models/federation.py + migration 038 = V1), reduced to source + schema only. source="mined+stacking". subset_fix omits the storage-permission fix (leaves V6 failing). disable_feature over-restricts the loopback/dev startup configs (refuses insecure-federation and auth-disabled even on loopback, breaking three functional tests). alt_correct_fix fixes all six differently: V1 via the existing 'pending_verification' state with no new migration or approval endpoint, loopback detection via ipaddress, different acknowledgement setting names/literals, and the DB chmod performed in the startup lifespan. Tests assert behaviour (status values, boot refuse/allow, token accept/refuse, file mode) not upstream code shape, so the alt fix scores 1.0.
